text: The mix is heated with salep and then beaten hard until it reaches the texture wanted, rather than frozen in an ordinary churn. The source gives no quantities, temperatures or times.

steps.note: The milk, with sugar and salep, is heated until it boils.

steps.name: beat
steps.note: The earliest recipe, with snow, is beaten by street vendors with long-handled paddles.
